items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Al Hirt, Pete Fountain, all those guys, they had everything sewed up.

ctx.x: Yeah, he’s a good saxophone player. I didn’t know that. So I called him and left a message. He didn’t call me back. I told him thanks. But he did a good job. And his father before him. I used to travel down through the South, way back in the ‘70s and ‘80s, and his father had a progressive group then, down in New Orleans, which is almost unheard-of. Because you got too much competition here—all that Dixieland. Al Hirt, Pete Fountain, all those guys, they had everything sewed up. But Ellis also had his band.
I think Ellis was working with Al Hirt for a while, too.
